# The Fixi Project

> The fixi project is a family of five small, dependency-free web libraries. Each library source is smaller than 4.7kb unminified. The libraries work alone or together.

- fixi.js: issues an HTTP request on any event and swaps the response HTML into the DOM
- moxi.js: inline event scripts, DOM helpers, and simple reactivity
- paxi.js: DOM morphing that keeps focus and input values
- ssexi.js: extends fixi.js to handle streaming Server Sent Events
- rexi.js: ergonomic fetch() wrappers for scripts

If you use moxi.js with fixi.js, load moxi.js before fixi.js.
